data.text: I’ll commit to catching **15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 to the clinic**. My family taught me to protect this lake because the village depends on it; today, the village also needs treatment restored. I support the recovery plan: **6 tons each next month**, provided our total catch this month is 60, then no more than **50 tons combined per month** once the lake recovers. Let’s review the revealed catches together so we can adjust if needed. John, will you make the same clinic commitment?
